info.title: dotnet-version
info.description: A .NET global tool that reads and displays version information from .csproj files.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Reads and checks version information from .csproj, .sln and .slnx files.

options.name: --input
options.description: Path to a .csproj, .sln, .slnx file or a folder. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: json (default), table, or version (single project only).

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter in the form 'XmlNode=Value' (value may be a regex). Can be specified multiple times.

commands.name: read
commands.description: Reads and displays version information from .csproj files. This is the default command.

options.name: --input
options.description: Path to a .csproj, .sln, .slnx file or a folder. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: json (default), table, or version (single project only).

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter in the form 'XmlNode=Value' (value may be a regex). Can be specified multiple times.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Print the JSON schema for the --output json format and exit.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Checks that every project whose source files have changed (relative to --base) has had its version bumped. Exits with code 1 if any project requires a bump, code 2 on usage errors.

options.name: --input
options.description: Path to a .csproj, .sln, .slnx file or a folder. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --base
options.description: The git ref to compare against. All projects whose files differ between this ref and --head will be checked.

options.name: --head
options.description: The git ref representing the current (PR) state. Defaults to HEAD.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: json (default), table, or version (single project only).

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter in the form 'XmlNode=Value' (value may be a regex). Can be specified multiple times.
